messages:
incident-bot: Pager: /page oncall - inference-api error-rate 5xx > 12% (us-east-1) for 4m. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/5xx. Paging: @Justin.

Justin (oncall): Ack. I'm on. Anyone seeing deploys?

Aisha (SRE): No deploys. I see bursts of 502 from model-proxy. Also noticing Datadog metric panels are frozen/backfilled; last datapoint ~11:02 UTC.

Carlos (infra): Confirmed. Datadog Status says "ingestion delays" — link: https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingest-latency-2026. Logs in Datadog appear incomplete.

Raj Patel: We're blind on most dashboards. Spawning immediate fallback: enabling CloudWatch metric streams to our emergency dashboard and creating temporary CloudWatch alarms.

Justin (oncall): Good. Also create synthetic health checks hitting /internal/ready across the fleet and wire them into PagerDuty as a fallback. We need reliable paging even while Datadog is flaky.

Aisha (SRE): Creating synthetic: ```for ip in $(cat nodes.txt); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://$ip/internal/ready || echo fail; done``` will run every 30s from our uptime probes. Adding alarm: > 3 nodes failing for 2 consecutive checks -> PD.

PagerDuty: New integration created: "Synthetic-Ready-Fallback" routing to inference-oncall schedule.

Meera (CS): Heads up - CS field reported two customers seeing API timeouts. Preparing a short notice: "We're investigating errors in the inference API in us-east-1. We're degrading retries and routing to healthy shards while observability is limited; we'll update in 30 minutes."

Carlos (infra): While dashboards are down I pulled raw ELB and NLB metrics from CloudWatch: increased 5xx at the LB layer starting 11:00 UTC, concentrated on target group tg-inference-7.

Aisha (SRE): Digging into model-proxy logs from the affected target group. Pattern: client request -> kv-lookup timeout -> proxy returns 502. There's a spike in backend latency for kv-store shard s7.

Justin (oncall): Hypothesis: one KV shard degraded causing retries and proxy queueing. Mitigation option: isolate shard s7 via routing rule and shift traffic to s3 and s4. Can we do a weighted routing change?

Carlos (infra): I can adjust the routing weights in the service mesh. Will move 40% away from s7 to s3/s4 now. Applying: `smctl route update inference --move-from s7 --pct 40`.

Raj Patel: Also enabling client-side retry throttle: backoff_multiplier=1.5 and max_retries=1 to reduce retry storm. Pushing config to fleet.

Datadog Status Bot: Update: Ingestion latency improving; logs and metrics will backfill but may be delayed. Support ticket DD-112233 opened.

Justin (oncall): Good. Raj, Carlos, Aisha: after you apply mitigations, please update CloudWatch alarms and post screenshots to the thread. We can't rely on Datadog to show progress.

Aisha (SRE): Routing change applied. Confirming via mesh logs: traffic to s7 dropped ~40%. CloudWatch target group error-rate for tg-inference-7 decreased 55% within 90s. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood/inci/1770024680/cc1.png

Raj Patel: Retry throttle pushed. Synthetic-Ready-Fallback shows 1 failing node left (s7 host-12). Creating ephemeral alert to PD if >1 node fails.

Meera (CS): Sending update to impacted customers: "We've applied mitigations (traffic redistribution + retry throttles) and errors are decreasing. Observability vendor is reporting backfill; we'll confirm when metrics are complete." Asking for approval from Justin.

Justin (oncall): Approved. If Datadog backfill completes and corroborates CloudWatch, we'll close the incident. If not, we keep it open for the next 2 hours to collect post-incident telemetry.

Carlos (infra): Quick note: I opened a support chat with Datadog support and uploaded our ingestion timestamps and API key identifiers. Link: https://app.datadoghq.com/support/cases/DD-112233. They asked for org logs and we're awaiting response.

Aisha (SRE): One more mitigation: enable local KV read cache fallback on the proxy for reads <100ms for 60s TTL. Rolling to one AZ first. If stable, we'll expand.

Justin (oncall): Roll to az-a only. Monitor CloudWatch error-rate and synthetic checks. Whoever is on-call after me, please own escalation to Datadog if DD-112233 has no engineer reply in 20m.

PagerDuty: Handoff acknowledged. Next oncall: Aisha for 11:20-11:50.

Aisha (SRE): Rolling cache fallback to az-a now. Early signal: error-rate on az-a hosts dropped 45% within 2m.

Datadog Status Bot: Backfill in progress. Some dashboards now rendering historic points.

Justin (oncall): Thanks team. I'll update the incident bridge summary and handoff notes. Postmortem owners: Aisha (technical root cause & mitigations), Carlos (routing changes & infra), Raj (alerting fallback), Meera (customer comms).

Meera (CS): Preparing follow-up note for enterprise customers with timeline and mitigations. Will include recommendation to set up account-level webhook alerts pointing to our synthetic fallback in case vendor outages recur.

Justin (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing active paging for me. Aisha owns until metrics fully reconcile and Datadog confirms backfill. Reacts: :white_check_mark: by Carlos, :eyes: by Raj.
